sections.heading: MINOR IN POLITICAL SCIENCE (Brescia) - admission discontinued
lines: Faculty of Social Science - Political Science
Admission to this module is discontinued effective September 1, 2025. Students enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfilment of the module requirements by August 31, 2029.
Completion of first-year requirements, including Political Science 1020E or Political Science 1021F/G and Political Science 1022F/G with a mark of at least 60%.
2.0 courses from: Political Science 2230E, Political Science 2231E, Political Science 2237E.
2.0 additional courses in Political Science at the 2200 level or above.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
